name: Gerald
design: A middle-aged British man with a soft, warm, unhurried voice, extremely polite and reassuring, gentle and calm like a hostage negotiator or a kindly human resources manager. A quiet smile in the voice. He never raises his voice and never sounds angry.
ref_text: Hello. Please, take a seat. Nobody's in trouble. I just want to have a little chat about your availability. One step at a time. That's completely valid.
